'''Nourishing Vita-Caps''' were a nutritional supplement available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were meant to be used as a quick, nourishing "meal" that would satisfy a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient's]] energy needs while being portable and quickly consumable.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nourishing Vita-Caps appeared as a reusable "buff" item in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Vita-Caps were a reward from an optional quest that could be obtained during the ''Legacy'' quest line, specifically the portion taking place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]; the quest was titled "The Life and Death of [[Jonni Skaak]]" and had the player follow Jonni's journey from [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] agent to leader of the [[Skaak Tippers]]. Once completed, the player would receive the Vita-Caps as a reward. They could be used to increase the player's constitution statistic by twenty for fifteen minutes, which would increase the player's health by a small amount.<ref name="SWG" />
